messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty — INCIDENT fired: latency_p95_slo_burn (sev: high). p95 > 480ms across us-west inference pool for 6m. Pager: oncall@redwood.

sam_oncall: ACK — I'm on it. jumping into dashboards and tracer. tagging @maya @jorge.

maya: saw the spike ~6:42. traces show long queue_wait on sidecar processes, tail requests piling at tokenization stage.

jorge: checking autoscaler logs now. last scale event stuck because nodepool quota returned 403 from cloud api. might be provisioning blockage.

support_sw: CS has two incoming tickets complaining about slow API responses for embeddings and chat completion in prod-us-west. Customer X reports timeouts in console. tagging for customer impact.

sam_oncall: good catch. mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic to eu-west for non-enterprise routes, 2) enable temporary route-fallback to compact-quant model for low-tier routes, 3) try manual warmup and restart of sidecar v2.1.

infra-bot: runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/latency-triage — recommends warming kv-cache and verifying autoscaler permissions.

maya: running warmup script against shards, starting kv-cache resync. paste of quick commands I ran:
```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/sidecar-v2
./scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh --region us-west --prefix sample_prompts
```

jorge: autoscaler logs show: 2026-05-18T06:39:12Z cloudapi: QuotaExceeded -> request rejected. I've opened a quota increase with cloud support, but that's slow. Workaround: spin up spare nodes in a different quota'd pool. kicking off now.

sam_oncall: initiating traffic-shift: setting routing policy to prefer eu-west for non-enterprise. Command: `rbctl route update --from us-west --to eu-west --filter 'tier!=enterprise' --dry-run` then deploy.

maya: KV-cache resync completed. p95 decreased to ~300ms within 3m. queue_depth still elevated but dropping.

incident-bot: PagerDuty — ACK recorded by sam_oncall. Escalation suppressed.

jorge: new nodes coming up in alt-pool, but still copying model shards, so some coldstarts. I'll add temporary reroute for model-heavy routes to model-lite.

sam_oncall: early customer impact summary: degraded latency for non-enterprise routes (embeddings/chat) in us-west for ~12m; some timeouts reported by Support for heavy batch workloads. No data exfiltration, no errors at platform auth layer.

support_sw: noted, I'll update the incident ticket and send first customer advisory: "We're investigating degraded response times in us-west; engineering mitigation in progress. ETA next update 15m."

maya: p95 now ~180ms, p99 ~640ms (still tailing). I'll keep an eye and roll sidecar back if any regressions.

jorge: nodes healthy, autoscaler workaround in place. filing a post-incident task to audit quota handling and add graceful fallback when scale calls fail.

sam_oncall: handing off — I need to step out in 20m. @jorge you take primary follow-up and postmortem owner. @maya please watch metrics for 30m and call if p99 > 800ms. I'll leave my status and notes in the incident doc.

jorge: taking it. will coordinate with infra to request permanent quota bump and schedule a remediation to make route-fallback automatic on scale failures.

incident-bot: PagerDuty — INCIDENT resolved (ack closed) by sam_oncall? Actually, sam acknowledged and escalations muted. Please update incident state when fully resolved.

sam_oncall: marking this as mitigated for now. next update: postmortem + action items within 48h. good job team. :thumbsup:
